vo1025001.title: Konica BIG mini NEO-R 35-70mm Zoom Compact 35mm Film Camera with Case
vo1025001.details: Konica BIG mini NEO-R compact 35mm film camera in silver with a 35-70mm f/3.5-7.4 zoom lens (5 groups, 6 elements), program auto exposure, shutter speeds from 4.5 to 1/360 sec, a closest focusing distance of 0.8 m at 35 mm and 0.6 m at 70 mm, and a weight of about 240 g. It uses one CR123A battery. Condition: Used. The camera powers on and operates with a new CR123A battery, which is included. Film winding and rewinding were not checked, and it has not been test-shot with film. The date imprint can only be set up to the year 2020, and it is currently set to 07. The body has few scratches and looks clean. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera, a leather case and the CR123A battery. No film or box is included. Please check the photos carefully for the exact condition.
vo1025001.why: A compact Konica zoom camera with a 35-70mm lens, a popular choice for point-and-shoot film photography.
vo1025001.perfect: Film photography beginners, travelers and collectors of compact Konica and Minolta cameras.
vo1025001.exp: The simple pleasure of shooting film with a pocketable zoom camera, shipped from Japan with tracking.
vo1025001.cd: Pre-owned. Powers on and operates with the included CR123A battery. Film winding and rewinding were not checked and it was not test-shot with film. The date imprint can only be set up to the year 2020. Few scratches. Leather case included. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
